description: This PHP file defines the class 'EditViewMetaParser', a utility for parsing and processing SugarCRM pre-5.0 'EditView.html' files to produce an 'editviewdefs.php' equivalent. It extends 'MetaParser' and contains methods for extracting metadata from HTML form layouts.

classes.name: EditViewMetaParser
classes.description: A parser class for converting legacy SugarCRM 'EditView.html' files into declarative PHP definitions, assisting in restoring or updating legacy UI metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, setting the view type to 'EditView'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that reads an HTML layout file, extracts form and layout metadata, and produces a corresponding PHP array structure representing the view's layout and fields.
